summary: Trend charts (sparklines) feature tested on Preços tab. Backend returns tendencia array in each apresentacao with monthly grouping (mes, medio, min, max, qtd). Frontend displays mini sparklines for presentations with 2+ data points, trend indicators with percentages and color coding (green=drop, red=rise), and expanded larger charts with 3 lines (Min/Medio/Max).

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - recharts ResponsiveContainer race condition on initial render. Does NOT affect functionality, charts render correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Backend _calcular_tendencia_mensal method groups items by YYYY-MM from data_homologacao
VERIFIED: tendencia field includes {mes, medio, min, max, qtd} for each month
VERIFIED: Data integrity: min <= medio <= max for all trend points
VERIFIED: Frontend only shows sparklines when tendencia.length >= 2 (as designed)
VERIFIED: Trend indicator color: emerald-50 (green) for price drops, red-50 for price rises
VERIFIED: Percentage calculated as ((last.medio - first.medio) / first.medio) * 100
VERIFIED: Period filter (meses) correctly reduces trend data points (3m shows ~3 points, 12m shows ~12 points)
VERIFIED: Expanded chart has XAxis (months), YAxis (R$ values), and 3 data series (max-yellow dashed, medio-blue solid, min-green dashed)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All trend chart components working correctly

seed_data_creation: None - uses live PNCP government portal data
